name: Australian Clinical Labs Limited
summary: Australian Clinical Labs Limited provides pathology diagnostic services in Australia. The company offers cardiac testing, gastroenterology, haematology, chemical pathology, antenatal testing, serology and microbiology, cervical screening, commercial drug and alcohol testing, STI Testing, veterinary pathology, molecular cancer services, clinical trials pathology, advanced genetic testing, functional pathology, histopathology and cytopathology, CPD education programs for clinicians, and allergy and immunology services.
